added: The Tab information overlay now shows the current time in its bottom-right corner.
changed: The "Loading — please wait" card at the bottom of the screen is no longer shown while the game loads a map or assets.
Update messages now show your installed version (for example "No newer release is available (installed runtime: 0.5.4)").
fixed: Windows: if installing an update fails, Qrazy now shows a short reason in the error message so it can be reported.

changed: Linux: with VSync off, the client now uses its own frame timing and a smaller garbage-collection pause, and the FPS counter shows frames actually shown. Set VSync with r_swapinterval and restart Qrazy; Maximum FPS (com_maxfps) is available too. VSync on is unchanged. If Qrazy closes unexpectedly with VSync off, VSync is turned back on at the next start.
The Tab overlay no longer shows YOU and WATCHING text, so the top cards and player rows keep the same height when the highlight moves. The highlighted background remains.
fixed: The game view could stay blurry or at the wrong refresh rate after moving Qrazy to another monitor or changing display scaling; it now refreshes itself.
Spectating no longer pulls Qrazy to the front when the game re-locks the mouse while the window is in the background.

changed: Windows: the game view now runs on its own processing thread, separate from the client window. In theory this should be better for input lag.
fixed: Windows: files saved from the game (configs, demos, HUD exports) now get the right file extension even when you type a name without one.

changed: Windows: file pickers opened by the game (such as for custom models) now show the file types the game asks for, instead of only image files.

added: The information overlay shows the time on the current map next to the session time.
Qrazy can now show a short message from the developers in the menu when something needs your attention, such as a reinstall.
changed: Windows: client updates now also replace the launcher (Qrazy.exe), so launcher fixes reach you without a manual reinstall.
fixed: Windows: fixed Qrazy refusing to start with "Qrazy runtime verification failed", most often on the second launch.
Windows: the installer now works when you reinstall into the same folder after uninstalling. Your saved profile is kept.

changed: Windows: the game view is now drawn directly by CEF, the embedded Chromium engine, inside the Qrazy window, replacing the separate copy-and-redraw step the old view used. Mouse look uses raw, unaccelerated input, and with VSync on the frame rate follows the monitor the window is on (Maximum FPS applies with VSync off). If the window cannot be created, Qrazy shows an error asking you to report it.
Downloads now have stable names, so permanent links always give the newest Windows ZIP, Windows installer and Linux AppImage.
The Tab overlay shows all players under a single column header, with less prominent YOU and WATCHING badges and highlights.

added: Windows: spray slots can now open a file picker to choose an image (PNG, JPG, GIF, WebP or BMP).

changed: Player numbers now appear beside names in the Tab overlay when the game provides them.
Linux: the opt-in experimental frame pacing now uses a reworked frame timer.
fixed: Windows: mouse capture now keeps the cursor confined to the window, and releases capture if Windows lifts the confinement (for example while moving or resizing the window).

added: Windows: the Client panel's Diagnostics now builds a readable graphics support report (system, GPU, display and game renderer details) with an optional box for describing FPS problems, included when you copy it.
fixed: Windows: frame timing now follows the monitor the window is on when you move it or change display settings.

changed: YOU and WATCHING badges now appear below the world-record details in the Tab overlay.
fixed: Automatic client update checks retry after startup or network failures instead of waiting through the normal cooldown.

added: Windows: VSync and Maximum FPS settings in the Display settings, saved and applied without a restart.
changed: Client updates reuse files you already have and download only what changed.
Windows: the FPS counter shows how many frames the client presents per second.
Windows: frame timing now follows your display's refresh rate or your Maximum FPS setting.
The ^4 blue in the Tab overlay is now a lighter blue.
fixed: Windows: mouse capture no longer fails after chat or the console when the cursor had left the window, and a failed capture now says why.
Page zoom from an earlier Ctrl+scroll no longer carries over between launches.
The picture stays sharp at fractional display scaling such as 125% or 150%.

added: Automatic client update notices in the menu show the available version and release notes, with Download, Install and Later options.
changed: Client and game updates now share one notice, with an option to refresh only the game.
fixed: Restored saving recorded demos, HUD/JSON exports and configuration files, including exports started during gameplay.
Fixed a Linux connection-retry timer that could show a connection failure after five minutes even when already connected.
Restored Linux client focus after a successful connection retry so mouse capture can resume without switching windows.

added: Right-click selected text to open a menu with a Copy option.
changed: Game update notices offer Refresh game or Keep playing, with a reminder in the menu.
fixed: Fixed a Windows client crash when opening maps and other dropdowns, including during multiplayer.
Prevented a Windows client crash when the game page has not finished drawing its first frame.
Website links now open in your default browser instead of being blocked by the SDL3/CEF client.

added: A QUIT button in the game menu closes the client.
changed: The Tab overlay highlights the world-record category for you or the player you are watching, with a YOU or WATCHING badge.
The Tab overlay displays smaller colored clan tags beside player names, with an underline for official clans.

added: Read the client changelog from Client updates, including offline release history and an indicator for unread release notes.
Automatic retries with a countdown and Retry now button when the server is temporarily unavailable.
changed: The Tab overlay shows spectators as separate labels and supports colored names and time differences versus the world record when supplied by the game.
fixed: Website links now open in your default browser instead of being blocked by the client.
Removed the duplicate game update popup so the client shows a single refresh notice.
